S_default_note: the amplitude anchor S_ref equals S_default; Phase 2 must read S_default from this file for the live budget

baseline.causality: block-local, no zero-phase two-pass filtering, 0.25 s look-ahead disclosed
baseline.simulation: S readouts simulated per navigation sample in 200-block chunks; refines QS-02's closed-form tone response because with the exact RPM channel the kept-harmonic response is identically zero and only sample-level simulation measures guard drops and dropped-harmonic leakage; research cost 0.03/0.12/0.47/2.13 s at S = 64/256/1024/4096 for 1500 blocks (CPython)
baseline.window: centred 0.5 s block: readouts in [t_k - 0.25 s, t_k + 0.25 s)

crust_within_sample: frozen at crust(t_k) for all windows and readouts of sample k (disclosed approximation)

equal_budget.S_meaning: S is an ensemble size, not sequential shots
equal_budget.ghz: GHZ-n at S shots compared with n unentangled qubits at S shots each (equal qubit-shots) and with the baseline magnetometer
equal_budget.ghz_track_accounting: the GHZ navigation track spends S coarse + S fine shots (disclosed)
equal_budget.readouts_per_sample: S readouts (baseline) vs S Ramsey shots (quantum) per navigation sample
equal_budget.rpm_channel: the same exact commanded RPM channel for both sensors
equal_budget.servo: servo windows are not counted in S; their noise cancels in the output
equal_budget.single_readout_noise_qs02: 1/(2*pi*gamma*tau0), the literal QS-02 / SC5 definition; it holds for the motor-off parity test, where tau_k = tau0 (both sensors also share the 1/c1 contrast factor)
equal_budget.single_readout_noise_refined: sigma1_k = 1/(2*pi*gamma*tau_k*c1) per navigation sample, tau_k = m*60/R_k from the shared RPM channel, tau0 = 10 ms without RPM; refines QS-02 because a baseline pinned at tau0 while the quantum tau_k follows the RPM differs by up to ~13% (RMS-equivalent tau 8.73 ms over the prior) and fails the 10% parity test, while the matched definition gives parity within 2.5% at every S (01-RESEARCH Check 5)

ghz.fallback: single-qubit coarse estimate, counted per sample

switch_rule.per_sample: coarse sample not fringe-risk (|phi_hat| <= pi/4 and 0 < n1 < S)

igrf_plane.source: lstsq of the SGL 1003.02 igrf channel vs local (x, y) in the Eastern_395 frame, computed once from the sister repo (line file not lifted); RMS 0.22 nT; hard-coded here

noise.sigma1_rule: sigma1_k = 1/(2*pi*gamma*tau_k*c1); tau_k = tau0 without RPM, so the motor-off single-readout noise is 1/(2*pi*gamma*tau0*c1)

notes: RPM-withheld (wrong-tau) path not built in Phase 1 (PD-1, cut order item 2); tau_rule.no_rpm kept

assumptions: tone amplitudes are a declared scenario assumption; c1 = 0.98 placeholder replaced by measured contrast in Phase 2; UAV INS 1.5 m/s bias / 0.1 rw; RPM channel exact; crust frozen within a navigation sample

servo.note: servo windows set the reference only; their noise cancels in the output and is not counted in S
servo.seed: IGRF plane + map value at the GPS fix

tau_rule.formula: tau_k = m*60/R(t_k), R at window start

tone_amplitude_rule.draw_seeds: seeds.int_seed(root, 'amp_cal', d), d = 0..draws-1; noise stream ('amp_cal', d, S_ref)
tone_amplitude_rule.estimator: baseline only (ls_guarded); no quantum estimator runs during the freeze
tone_amplitude_rule.exact_cancellation: a draw with L1 <= 1e-09 per unit A1 (no dropped harmonic) has no finite solution; it is recorded as null and skipped in the median
tone_amplitude_rule.rule: A1 such that the guarded-LS baseline leftover RMS after the jam = ratio x median 120-sample window std of the true anomaly (stride 20 from the jam); sqrt((A1*L1)^2 + floor^2) = target per draw; median over draws; 2 significant figures
